seoTitle: Fulton County Schools Calendar 2027-2028: Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Fulton County Schools 2027-2028 calendar with Aug 2 first day, May 25 last day, fall break, Thanksgiving, winter break, spring break and PDF.
heroSummary: Fulton County Schools begins the 2027-2028 school year on Monday, August 2, 2027. The final student day is Thursday, May 25, 2028. Fall Break runs Sep 27-Oct 1, 2027, Thanksgiving Break runs Nov 22-26, 2027, and Spring Break runs Apr 3-7, 2028.
calendarNotes: Fulton County Schools lists 180 instructional days for 2027-2028, with 88 days in the first semester and 92 days in the second semester. Students start on August 2, 2027 and finish on May 25, 2028. Fall Break runs September 27 through October 1, Thanksgiving Break runs November 22-26, December Break runs December 20-31, Winter Break runs February 21-25, and Spring Break runs April 3-7. The official PDF also notes that statewide election days will be remote for students unless otherwise indicated.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Fulton County Schools start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fulton County Schools starts the 2027-2028 school year on Monday, August 2, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fulton County Schools Fall Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, September 27 through Friday, October 1, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for Fulton County Schools in 2027-2028?
calendarFaqs.a: December Break runs December 20-31, 2027. The calendar also lists Winter Break from February 21-25, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fulton County Schools Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 3 through Friday, April 7, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in the Fulton 2027-2028 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The approved Fulton County Schools 2027-2028 calendar lists 180 instructional days for students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Fulton County Schools in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 25, 2028.
